title: Christmas Day Feast at The Conti
summary: The Continental Sorrento hosts Christmas Day lunch in Halcyon Hall, the Grand Ballroom and CeeCee’s. The shared feast includes seafood and charcuterie, followed by Christmas ham, sirloin and barramundi. The organiser lists an 11:30am sitting in Halcyon Hall and the Grand Ballroom, and a 1pm sitting at CeeCee’s; check the venue for current booking details.
